async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Locate the search box and fill it with the article title
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("complementary").get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await searchbox.fill("Making Your Code Base Better Will Make Your Code Coverage Worse")
    
    # Step 2: Click the search button
    search_button = page.get_by_role("complementary").get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    
    # Step 3: Wait for the search results page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 4: Look for the article link in the search results
    # Assuming the article appears as a link with the exact title
    article_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Making Your Code Base Better Will Make Your Code Coverage Worse", exact=True)
    await article_link.click()
    
    # Step 5: Wait for the article page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 6: Verify the article title on the new page
    # Check for a heading or article title to confirm
    article_heading = page.get_by_role("heading", name="Making Your Code Base Better Will Make Your Code Coverage Worse", exact=True)
    if await article_heading.is_visible():
        # Article found, terminate with result
        return
    else:
        # If not found, maybe search didn't work; fallback or error
        raise Exception("Article not found after search.")
